class.name: SVGAnimate2D
class.brief_description: Editable and keyframeable SVG path node for 2D.
class.description: Exposes rendered SVG path anchors and basic-shape points (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon) as paths/path_N/point_N and actual cubic controls as in_handle/out_handle child properties. Arc and straight segments keep their SVG command type and have no cubic handles. Per-path fill_color/stroke_color (or fill_paint/stroke_paint for non-solid paints), fill_opacity, stroke_opacity and stroke_width are keyframeable. Color properties interpolate; paint strings preserve gradients and none as discrete values. The editor can add individual keys from a point's right-click menu or create an AnimationPlayer with initial keys for all anchors, cubic handles, paint settings and node modulate. Editor tools move existing anchors and handles without adding or deleting paths or points. Edited basic shapes retain their original element name and styling; the source SVG file is not changed. Non-rendered definitions and fully transparent geometry do not expose editor points. Reused paths expose a control at each rendered use instance. Controls follow viewBox, preserveAspectRatio, nested group and path transforms, node transforms, and flips. Enable animation_enabled for the same four-pattern hand-drawn jitter as SVG2D. Path edits preserve the jitter playback phase. Jitter affects rasterized outlines only: editor anchors, handles, hit positions and saved keyframes always use unjittered path coordinates. cache_animation_frames is disabled by default to reuse one texture during continuous path deformation. Enable it for static shapes when avoiding rerasterization is preferable.

method.name: get_edited_svg
method.description: Returns SVG markup with current path and paint edits, including pending deferred edits. Preserves inherited styles. Does not apply display jitter or change the original src.

method.name: get_path_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of rendered instances of a path, including uses of a definition.

method.name: path_to_document
method.description: Maps a path-local point into document coordinates for the first rendered instance.

method.name: document_to_path
method.description: Maps document coordinates into path-local coordinates for the first rendered instance.

method.name: path_to_document_instance
method.description: Maps a path-local point into document coordinates for a rendered instance.

method.name: document_to_path_instance
method.description: Maps document coordinates back to path-local coordinates for a rendered instance.

method.name: flush_paths
method.description: Applies pending path edits immediately. Call before reading a texture when deferred_updates is enabled. SVGAnimate3D still refreshes its displayed texture at idle time.

method.name: clear_animation_cache
method.description: Releases animation history and resets its hit/miss counters. The current display remains available.

method.name: get_animation_cache_bytes
method.description: Returns accounted history bytes for image pixels including mipmaps, stored SVG strings and entry metadata. Excludes current display references, renderer work buffers, driver overhead and allocator overhead.

method.name: get_animation_cache_frame_count
method.description: Returns retained frame count. At most 512 frames are kept, also constrained by animation_cache_limit_mb.

method.name: get_animation_cache_hits
method.description: Returns successful history lookups since the last clear, source replacement or mode change. Repeated reads of the already current texture do not increment this counter.

method.name: get_animation_cache_misses
method.description: Returns failed history lookups since the last clear, source replacement or mode change.

signal.name: source_changed
signal.description: Emitted after src is set and the editable geometry has been replaced. Path and paint edits alone do not emit this signal.

members.member: 0: Disabled. 1: Exact Frames. Exact Frames is the default. It reuses immutable textures when the same serialized path state, integer resolution, jitter amount, jitter pattern and mipmap setting recur, skipping SVG parsing, rasterization and texture upload on a hit. No time or coordinate quantization is applied. Best suited to repeated poses or deterministic frame sampling; continuously varying poses may not hit. Explicit src replacement clears history. Editor anchors and handles retain their original coordinates.

History budget in MiB (1–256). Least recently used frames are evicted first. A single frame exceeding the budget is rendered without retention. Lowering the limit trims history immediately. Current display references and renderer work buffers are separate from this budget.
Combines path edits until idle time, serializing and parsing the SVG once per batch. Point getters and scene saving always see current edits. Disable for immediate SVG parsing.
